sources: technique video dhSKkQdUzoA, its loop in review/loops.json
exercises.json: a 30° or 45° bench, a second's pause at the bottom
docs/research/grip.md, 2.1: a press loads the palm heel along the forearm

lines.says: the elbows open to near straight at the top and close deep at the bottom, the hands beside the upper chest
the hips stay on the pad
the head stays on the pad
the shoulders stay pinned to the pad
the hands press on a near-straight line
the upper arms keep their angle to the trunk: no tuck and flare mid-rep

lines.open: The 0° clip alone, 21.9° against 20, and the owner OK'd it. The limit was fitted to db_bench_press, so the limit may be what's wrong: the owner's call.

lines.says: a bell never rocks mid-rep: its tilt runs evenly from the top to the bottom
a bell never spins about its handle
the wrist gives under the load, never rigid
the hand's roll runs evenly through the rep
at the bottom the forearms stand about in line with the press, under the bells
the arms lock out straight up, the bells over the shoulders, at every bench angle
